metadata.question: Does the plume at (69.264212, -136.275745) discharged by the Mackenzie River into the Beaufort Sea apprear more milky compared to the adjacent open ocean (69.803894, -137.786365) waters in July 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR on 2017-07-19 for the AOI (two buffered points). If empty, try Sentinel-2 TOA same day; if still empty, widen to ±3 days for SR then TOA. Mosaic and analyze. 2. Masking strategy: For water analysis, mask clouds/shadows/snow (S2 SCL for SR; QA60 for TOA) and keep water via NDWI > 0. This avoids land contamination while allowing turbid water. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Count valid pixels per ROI; if 0 => C2. Compute NDTI and green reflectance; if any result is null/NaN or NDTI magnitude > 1.5 => C3. Otherwise compare plume > ocean for both NDTI and brightness. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line async function getInfoAsync(obj) { return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo((res, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(res))); }); } function maskS2SR(img) { var scl = img.select('SCL'); var cloud = scl.eq(3).or(scl.eq(8)).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10)).or(scl.eq(11)); var ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); var waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); var mask = cloud.not().and(waterMask); return img.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); } function maskS2TOA(img) { var qa = img.select('QA60'); var cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0)); var ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); var waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); var mask = cloud.not().and(waterMask); return img.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); } function prepareS2SR(start, end, aoi) { var col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2SR); return col; } function prepareS2TOA(start, end, aoi) { var col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVERAGE_ASSESSMENT', 80)) .map(maskS2TOA); return col; } async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var plumePt = ee.Geometry.Point([-136.275745, 69.264212]); var oceanPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.786365, 69.803894]); var bufM = 1000; var plume = plumePt.buffer(bufM); var ocean = oceanPt.buffer(bufM); var unionAOI = plume.union(ocean); var start = '2017-07-19'; var end = '2017-07-20'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (with fallbacks) var dataset = null; var used = null; var colSR = prepareS2SR(start, end, unionAOI); var nSR = await getInfoAsync(colSR.size()); if (nSR > 0) { dataset = colSR; used = 'S2_SR'; } else { var colTOA = prepareS2TOA(start, end, unionAOI); var nTOA = await getInfoAsync(colTOA.size()); if (nTOA > 0) { dataset = colTOA; used = 'S2_TOA'; } else { // widen window ±3 days var startW = '2017-07-16'; var endW = '2017-07-22'; var colSRw = prepareS2SR(startW, endW, unionAOI); var nSRw = await getInfoAsync(colSRw.size()); if (nSRw > 0) { dataset = colSRw; used = 'S2_SR(±3d)'; } else { var colTOAw = prepareS2TOA(startW, endW, unionAOI); var nTOAw = await getInfoAsync(colTOAw.size()); if (nTOAw > 0) { dataset = colTOAw; used = 'S2_TOA(±3d)'; } else { console.log('Collections: S2_SR=0, S2_TOA=0, widened=0'); console.log('C1'); return; } } } } var nImgs = await getInfoAsync(dataset.size()); var image = dataset.mosaic().clip(unionAOI); // 3. Pixel counts to detect C2 and cloud % var scale = 1000; // Valid pixels per ROI after masking: count of B3 pixels var plumeCount = await getInfoAsync( image.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: plume, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3') ); var oceanCount = await getInfoAsync( image.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: ocean, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3') ); if (!plumeCount || !oceanCount || plumeCount === 0 || oceanCount === 0) { console.log(`${used} Images: ${nImgs}; Valid px (plume,ocean): ${plumeCount || 0}, ${oceanCount || 0}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // Cloud percent over AOI (using SCL or QA60, regardless of masking) var cloudPct; if (used.startsWith('S2_SR')) { var sclMosaic = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(unionAOI) .filterDate('2017-07-16', '2017-07-22') .mosaic() .select('SCL') .clip(unionAOI); var cloudMask = sclMosaic.eq(3).or(sclMosaic.eq(8)).or(sclMosaic.eq(9)).or(sclMosaic.eq(10)).or(sclMosaic.eq(11)); var cloudCount = await getInfoAsync( cloudMask.rename('c').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: unionAOI, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('c') ); var totalCount = await getInfoAsync( ee.Image.constant(1).rename('o').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: unionAOI, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('o') ); cloudPct = totalCount ? (100 * (cloudCount || 0) / totalCount) : null; } else { var qaMosaic = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(unionAOI) .filterDate('2017-07-16', '2017-07-22') .mosaic() .select('QA60') .clip(unionAOI); var cloudMaskTOA = qaMosaic.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qaMosaic.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0)); var cloudCount = await getInfoAsync( cloudMaskTOA.rename('c').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: unionAOI, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('c') ); var totalCount = await getInfoAsync( ee.Image.constant(1).rename('o').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: unionAOI, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('o') ); cloudPct = totalCount ? (100 * (cloudCount || 0) / totalCount) : null; } // 4. Calculation: NDTI, green reflectance, visible brightness var ndtiImg = image.normalizedDifference(['B4', 'B3']).rename('NDTI'); var visMeanImg = image.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']).divide(10000).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); // pixelwise mean across VIS bands var ndtiPlume = await getInfoAsync( ndtiImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: plume, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDTI') ); var ndtiOcean = await getInfoAsync( ndtiImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: ocean, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDTI') ); var greenPlume = await getInfoAsync( image.select('B3').divide(10000).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: plume, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3') ); var greenOcean = await getInfoAsync( image.select('B3').divide(10000).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: ocean, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3') ); var visPlume = await getInfoAsync( visMeanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: plume, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean') ); var visOcean = await getInfoAsync( visMeanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: ocean, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean') ); // 5. Validation & Final Answer function invalid(x) { return x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x); } if (invalid(ndtiPlume) || invalid(ndtiOcean) || invalid(greenPlume) || invalid(greenOcean) || invalid(visPlume) || invalid(visOcean) || Math.abs(ndtiPlume) > 1.5 || Math.abs(ndtiOcean) > 1.5) { console.log(`${used} Images: ${nImgs}; Valid px (plume,ocean): ${plumeCount}, ${oceanCount}`); if (cloudPct !== null && cloudPct !== undefined) console.log(`Cloud% (AOI): ${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`); console.log('C3'); return; } var ndtiHigher = ndtiPlume > ndtiOcean; var visHigher = visPlume > visOcean; console.log(`${used} Images: ${nImgs}; Window: ${used.includes('±3d') ? '±3d' : 'day'}`); if (cloudPct !== null && cloudPct !== undefined) console.log(`Cloud% (AOI): ${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`Valid px (plume,ocean): ${plumeCount}, ${oceanCount}`); console.log(`NDTI (plume, ocean): ${ndtiPlume.toFixed(3)}, ${ndtiOcean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Green refl ρ (plume, ocean): ${greenPlume.toFixed(3)}, ${greenOcean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`VIS mean ρ (plume, ocean): ${visPlume.toFixed(3)}, ${visOcean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Plume > Ocean in NDTI and VIS: ${ndtiHigher && visHigher}`); if (ndtiHigher && visHigher) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (e) { console.log(`Error: ${e}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
